framesHead.title: The type
framesHead.blurb: Six faces. Each one has a job, and this is the job.

frames.name: Epilogue
frames.why: The only face here set heavy enough to hold a wall up.

frames.name: Fira Sans
frames.why: Drawn for small screen text. It stays legible at the size labels actually are.

frames.name: Lora
frames.why: A serif set against all that grey. Gives the structure a voice that is not shouting.

frames.name: Lexend Deca
frames.specimen: A place of constant growth and decay.
frames.why: Designed for reading proficiency, so it carries the line directly under a title.

frames.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next
frames.why: Shapes drawn apart from each other on purpose, so long text does not fatigue.
frames.used: All body copy, here and in the essays.

frames.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono
frames.why: Fixed width, so numbers and frame labels line up without effort.
